title: छाउपडी उपन्यासमा लैङ्गिकता {Gender in Chhaupadi Novel}
nepali: प्रस्तुत लेखमा कविता पौडेलद्वारा रचित छाउपडी उपन्यासको लैङ्गिकताको अध्ययन गरिएको छ । समाजद्वारा लिङ्गका आधारमा नारी र पुरुषबिच गरिने सामाजिक, आर्थिक, धार्मिक, सांस्कृतिक आदि विभेदलाई लैङ्गिकता भनिन्छ । छाउपडी उपन्यासमा केकस्तो लैङ्गिकताको अवस्था रहेको छ भन्ने मूल समस्यामा केन्द्रित रही उपन्यासको लैङ्गिकताको अध्यययन गर्नु यस लेखको उद्देश्य हो । लैङ्गिकताको परिचय दिई लैङ्गिक समालोचनाले कृति विश्लेषणका लागि अगाडि सारेका पितृसत्ता, शरीर, लैङ्गिक विभेद, लैङ्गिक सशक्तीकरण जस्ता उपकरणको प्रयोग गरी उपन्यासको विश्लेषण गरिएको छ । यस उपन्यासमा नेपाली समाजमा कायम रहेका सामाजिक शासनव्यवस्थाका कारण नारीमाथि हुने गरेका दमन तथा हिंसाका विरुद्धमा नारीहरूले सशक्त रूपमा आवाज उठाउन तथा प्रतिकार गर्न थालेको अवस्थालाई उपन्यासमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ । नारीको शरीरमाथि आफ्नो अधिकार जमाउन प्रयास गर्ने, दमन र शोषण गरेर महिलालाई आफ्नो अधीनस्त बनाउन चाहने पुरुष प्रवृत्तिको विरोध उपन्यासले गरेको छ । यसमा लैङ्गिक रूपमा उत्पीडित भई सीमान्तीकृत बन्न पुगेका नारी पात्रको प्रतिनिधित्व गराइएको छ । नेपाली समाज पितृसत्तात्मक सामाजिक संरचनामा आधारित भएकाले सुरुमा नारीको पहिचान कमजोर भए पनि अन्त्यमा उत्पीडित महिलाले उत्पीडनका विरुद्ध प्रतिरोध गरेको देखाएर सीमान्तीकृत नारी समुदाय शक्तिशाली भएको निष्कर्ष प्राप्त भएको छ ।
american_english: The present article studies gender in the Chhaupadi novel written by Kavita Paudel. Gender refers to the social, economic, religious, cultural and other discriminations made between women and men on the basis of sex by society. Focusing on the main problem of what kind of gender situation exists in the Chhaupadi novel, studying gender in the novel is the objective of this article. Introducing gender, the novel has been analyzed using tools put forward by gender criticism for textual analysis, such as patriarchy, body, gender discrimination and gender empowerment. In this novel, the situation in which women have begun to raise their voices strongly and to resist the oppression and violence inflicted on women due to the social governing systems prevailing in Nepali society is presented. The novel opposes the male tendency that tries to establish authority over women's bodies and wants to subjugate women through oppression and exploitation. It represents women characters who, having been oppressed on gender grounds, have become marginalized. Because Nepali society is based on a patriarchal social structure, although women's identity is weak at the beginning, by showing that oppressed women resisted oppression at the end, the conclusion is reached that the marginalized women's community has become powerful.
british_english: The present article examines gender in the Chhaupadi novel authored by Kavita Paudel. Gender denotes the social, economic, religious, cultural and other forms of discrimination practised between women and men on the basis of sex by society. The aim of this article is to study gender in the novel, centring on the central problem of what gender situation obtains in the Chhaupadi novel. After introducing gender, the novel is analysed through tools advanced by gender critique for textual analysis, such as patriarchy, the body, gender discrimination and gender empowerment. In this novel is presented the situation in which women have begun to raise their voices forcefully and to resist the oppression and violence visited upon women by the social governing systems prevailing in Nepali society. The novel opposes the male disposition that seeks to assert authority over women's bodies and to reduce women to subjection through oppression and exploitation. It gives representation to women characters who, having been oppressed on grounds of gender, have been marginalised. Since Nepali society is founded on a patriarchal social structure, although women's identity is weak at first, by showing that oppressed women resisted oppression in the end, the conclusion is reached that the marginalised community of women has become powerful.

informal_english: This article looks at gender in Kavita Paudel's Chhaupadi novel. Gender, here, means the social, economic, religious, cultural and other kinds of discrimination society dishes out between women and men on the basis of sex. The aim is to study gender in the novel, zeroing in on the big question of what the gender situation actually looks like in Chhaupadi. After introducing gender, the novel gets analysed with tools gender criticism puts forward for reading texts — patriarchy, the body, gender discrimination and gender empowerment. The novel shows women starting to speak up strongly and push back against the oppression and violence inflicted on them by the social systems running the show in Nepali society. It also pushes back against the male tendency to try and claim authority over women's bodies and keep women down through oppression and exploitation. It features women characters who've been oppressed because of their gender and end up marginalised. Because Nepali society is built on a patriarchal structure, women's identity starts out weak, but by showing oppressed women resisting that oppression in the end, the conclusion is that the marginalised women's community has become powerful.
